featured.describedByText: The last stretch of episode reliability. Beat 1: At 95% success per decision, this thirty-decision toy episode succeeds about 21.5% of the time. Beat 2: Raising conditional success from 95% to 99% changes the thirty-step outcome from 21.5% to 74.0%. Beat 3: At 99.9% per decision, the same model gives 97.0% for thirty steps. Beat 4: The same horizon exposes the last stretch.
